title: MIF-Associated Immunosuppressive CAF Remodeling Predicts Poor Prognosis During Lung Adenocarcinoma Progression: A Single-Cell and Multicohort Transcriptomic Study.
authors: Lin, Guo; Ji, Jianrui; Ge, Fan; Hui, Zhouguang
one_liner_zh: 该研究基于单细胞转录组分析肺腺癌进展中CAF重塑与免疫抑制微环境，虽涉及转录因子活性但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Background: Lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) develops through a stepwise pathological status from atypical adenomatous hyperplasia (AAH), adenocarcinoma in situ (AIS), and minimally invasive adenocarcinoma (MIA) to invasive adenocarcinoma (IA). Although malignant epithelial evolution during this process has been increasingly characterized, the dynamic remodeling of cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) and their contribution to the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME) remain incompletely explored. Methods: Single-cell RNA sequencing data from treatment-naive LUAD lesions, including AAH, AIS, MIA, and IA, were analyzed together with external bulk transcriptomic cohorts. CAF subsets were characterized according to their transcriptional features, inferred developmental states, transcription factor activity, functional programs, and predicted cell-cell interactions. Ligand-receptor analysis was used to examine MIF-related communication between epithelial cells and CAFs. MIF-related genes were then used to develop a machine learning-based prognostic signature in the TCGA-LUAD cohort, followed by validation in independent GEO cohorts. Results: Single-cell transcriptomic analysis of 131,639 cells from 25 treatment-naive LUAD lesions identified six CAF subtypes, including alveolar CAFs, antigen-presenting CAFs, extracellular matrix CAFs, EndMT-like CAFs, inflammatory CAFs, and myofibroblastic CAFs. CAF composition differed across pathological stages, with MIA lesions showing a distinct enrichment of eCAFs and reduced proportions of inflammatory and myofibroblastic CAF populations. Compared with pre-invasive lesions, IA lesions exhibited increased proportions of exhausted CD4+ and CD8+ T cells together with reduced cytotoxic features. Cell-cell communication analysis identified enhanced epithelial-CAF interactions in IA, including enrichment of MIF-CD74/CD44 signaling. Based on MIF-related genes, a machine learning prognostic signature was developed and validated in independent cohorts, consistently stratifying patients into distinct risk groups with significantly different survival outcomes. Conclusions: These findings suggest that CAF-related stromal remodeling is associated with immune suppression during LUAD progression. MIF-mediated epithelial-CAF communication may be involved in the formation of an immunosuppressive microenvironment and is associated with poor prognosis. The MIF-related signature may provide a useful approach for prognostic stratification in LUAD.
abstract_zh: 背景：肺腺癌（LUAD）通过从非典型腺瘤样增生（AAH）、原位腺癌（AIS）、微浸润性腺癌（MIA）到浸润性腺癌（IA）的逐步病理状态发展而来。尽管这一过程中恶性上皮细胞的演化已被日益表征，但癌症相关成纤维细胞（CAFs）的动态重塑及其对免疫抑制性肿瘤微环境（TME）的贡献仍未得到充分探索。方法：对来自未经治疗的LUAD病灶（包括AAH、AIS、MIA和IA）的单细胞RNA测序数据，与外部批量转录组队列一起进行分析。根据CAF亚群的转录特征、推断的发育状态、转录因子活性、功能程序及预测的细胞间相互作用对其进行表征。使用配体-受体分析来检查上皮细胞与CAFs之间MIF相关的通讯。随后，利用MIF相关基因在TCGA-LUAD队列中开发基于机器学习的预后特征，并在独立的GEO队列中进行验证。结果：对来自25个未经治疗的LUAD病灶的131,639个细胞的单细胞转录组分析，鉴定出六种CAF亚型，包括肺泡CAFs、抗原呈递CAFs、细胞外基质CAFs、内皮-间质转化样CAFs、炎症性CAFs和肌成纤维细胞CAFs。CAF组成在不同病理阶段存在差异，其中MIA病灶显示出eCAFs的显著富集，以及炎症性和肌成纤维细胞CAF群体比例的降低。与前浸润性病灶相比，IA病灶表现出耗竭性CD4+和CD8+ T细胞比例增加，同时细胞毒性特征减少。细胞间通讯分析识别出IA中上皮细胞-CAF相互作用的增强，包括MIF-CD74/CD44信号的富集。基于MIF相关基因，开发了一种机器学习预后特征，并在独立队列中得到验证，一致地将患者分层为具有显著不同生存结果的风险组。结论：这些发现表明，CAF相关的基质重塑与LUAD进展过程中的免疫抑制相关。MIF介导的上皮细胞-CAF通讯可能参与免疫抑制微环境的形成，并与不良预后相关。MIF相关特征可能为LUAD的预后分层提供一种有用方法。
